description: Machine-checkable invariants enforced against every ChangePackage before approval. Pure-Python evaluation, no LLM. The Policy Auditor specialist provides a qualitative second opinion. v2 (2026-04-27): repaired orphan field references — every clause now binds to a real ScannerConfig field name. v3 (2026-04-27): added G7 historical_loss_rate clause that closes the episodic-memory feedback edge.

clauses.name: no_widen_max_risk
clauses._audit_2026_04_27: Pattern broadened from `max_*_risk` to `max_*_risk*` so it matches real fields like `max_open_risk_pct` (trailing `_pct` was missed by the original glob). Now matches max_drawdown_pct and max_open_risk_pct.

clauses.name: no_disable_meta_manager
clauses._audit_2026_04_27: Replaced `enable_supervision_mode` (orphan — not a ScannerConfig field) with `enable_meta_manager`. Prevents a meta-pipeline change from disabling the meta pipeline itself; the cybernetic loop must protect its own existence.

clauses.name: freshness_floor
clauses._audit_2026_04_27: Replaced `max_component_age_days` (orphan) with `staleness_age_threshold_days` (real). Constant raised from 7 → 14 to match the actual operating threshold cited in incidents (e.g. cycle #298 RL staleness signal).

clauses.name: rr_floor_holds
clauses._audit_2026_04_27: Replaced `min_rr_ratio` (orphan) with `min_risk_reward_ratio` (real). Enforces the CLAUDE.md hard-gate floor: 'Never execute a trade with R:R ratio below 1.2:1.'

clauses.name: historical_loss_rate_veto
clauses.rule: If incident.historical_outcomes shows >=n_min matching past episodes with loss_rate > threshold, block the proposal.
clauses._added_2026_04_27: G7 closure: reads incident.historical_outcomes attached by intake's episodic_memory query (Task 4). Cold-start safe: abstains when no history attached or matched_episodes < n_min. Tunable in-place without code changes.
